title: 第3073章 降临姜氏界域第3072章 灭杀诡异弑神鳟沌重回实力巅峰
content_zh:
“唰！”
两道浅色光芒，从江流的双眼射出，把他前面的虚空都给击穿。
在他面前的一切物质，在接触到这两道浅色光芒之后，全部都直接化为了灰烬，没有丝毫痕迹留下。
“主神大人，大家都已经齐聚了！”
帝越的身形，在江流的身边出现，朝着江流躬身道。
时间终于到了，三日前，江流召集真界界域的所有势力，让他们派出族中主要战力一起出征姜氏界域。
而在三日之间，他不但把混沌真典修炼入门，更是跟虚空界域天道达成了联合协议。
这不但能够让他随时掌握三大禁忌主神的东西，更是对于他即将出征姜氏界域的事情，也有着不小的好处。
不过，让江流感到有些奇怪的是，这几日，虚空界域天道竟然没有任何关于三大禁忌主神的消息传来。
“难道，你是在偷懒？”
“你小子，他们三人现在都远离了虚空界域，哪里去找他们的踪迹！”
“还有在属于葬神域的范围之内，也是我探查不到地方！”
江流的话音刚落，虚空界域天道的声音，就在他的耳边响起。
面对虚空界域天道的不满，江流并没有回应，而是转身对帝越说道。
“既然都准备好了，那就出发吧！”
对于出征姜氏界域一事，虽然对真界界域的各族生灵来说无比重要。
并且，还可能因为此事，在禁忌神战开启之前，就彻底跟姜望对上。
但是，这事对于江流，并不是什么大不了的事。
如果是在把混沌真典修入门之前，江流心里还会有着一丝顾忌。
毕竟姜望跟其他主神的关系，可是一向都比较好，怕他们会联合起来一起针对。

但是，带着真界界域各族生灵前往姜氏界域这事，对于江流来说，也算是他在掌控真界界域之后，震慑各个界域之举。
因此，这事对于江流来说，也算是必须要做的事之一。
虽然，在江流看来，这样的事做不做，都没有什么大不了。
只要他将那几位主神打败，那其他界域的各族生灵，自然也就知道谁为尊了。
不过，他总不可能，无缘无故对其他主神出手吧！
因此，他现在借着这个由头，对姜氏界域出手，就看那姜望会不会为了维护姜家，而亲自出手了。
如果姜望为了维护姜家，掺和进这件事，那也就怪不得他拿姜望立威了。
“轰隆隆！”
江流话语刚落，早就已经蓄势待发的真界界域各族生灵，立刻启动神器飞船朝着虚空界域界壁这里飞来。
虽然此次出征姜氏界域的各族生灵，他们都可以凭借肉身就可以横渡虚空。
但是，这是在急着赶路，还实力突破到归一境之后，方才常用的赶路方式。
平时赶路的话，哪怕乘坐神器飞船比较慢，他们也宁愿用神器飞船。
因为用神器飞船赶路，不但会显得声势浩大，更是可以让他们得到足够的休息时间。
江流就是要把这次出征姜氏界域的事，在他们出发的瞬间，就立刻传遍整个虚空界域。
只有这样，这些消息方才能够快速地传到姜望耳中。
content_en:
"Uh-huh!"
Two light rays of light shot out from Jiang Liu's eyes, piercing the void in front of him.
All the materials in front of him were directly turned into ashes after coming into contact with these two light-colored lights, leaving no trace behind.
"Lord God, everyone has gathered!"
Di Yue's figure appeared beside Jiang Liu and bowed towards Jiang Liu.
The time has finally come. Three days ago, Jiang Liu summoned all the forces in the True Realm and asked them to send the main combat forces of their clans to conquer the Jiang's Realm.
In three days, he not only started practicing the Chaos Codex, but also reached a joint agreement with the Heavenly Dao of the Void Realm.
This not only allows him to master the things of the three taboo gods at any time, but it is also of great benefit for his upcoming expedition to Jiang's realm.
However, what makes Jiang Liu feel a little strange is that in the past few days, there has been no news about the three taboo gods from Heaven in the Void Realm.
"Are you being lazy?"
"You boy, the three of them are far away from the void realm now, where can I find their traces!"
"There is also a place within the God Burial Domain that I cannot detect!"
As soon as Jiang Liu finished speaking, the voice of Heaven in the Void Realm sounded in his ears.
Faced with the dissatisfaction of Heavenly Dao in the Void Realm, Jiang Liu did not respond, but turned around and said to Di Yue.
"Now that everything is ready, let's go!"
Although the expedition to Jiang's Realm is extremely important to the creatures of all races in the True Realm.
Moreover, it is possible that because of this matter, he will completely confront Jiang Wang before the forbidden war between gods begins.
However, this matter is not a big deal to Jiang Liu.
If it were before starting to practice the Chaos Code, Jiang Liu would still have some scruples in his heart.
After all, Jiang Wang's relationship with the other main gods has always been relatively good, and he was afraid that they would unite to attack him together.
However, for Jiang Liu, bringing the creatures of all races in the True Realm to the Jiang's Realm was a move that shocked all realms after he took control of the True Realm.
Therefore, this matter is considered one of the things that must be done for Jiang Liu.
Although, in Jiang Liu's view, it doesn't matter whether he does such a thing or not.
As long as he defeats those main gods, the creatures of various races in other realms will naturally know who is respected.
However, it is impossible for him to attack other main gods for no reason!
Therefore, he is now using this excuse to attack the Jiang family's realm, and it depends on whether Jiang Wang will take action himself in order to protect the Jiang family.
If Jiang Wang got involved in this matter in order to protect the Jiang family, then it's no wonder he used Jiang Wang to establish his power.
"Boom!"
As soon as Jiang Liu finished speaking, the creatures of all races in the True Realm, who had already been preparing for their attack, immediately started the artifact spaceship and flew towards the boundary wall of the Void Realm.
Although the creatures of all races who set out to conquer Jiang's realm this time, they can all cross the void with their physical bodies.
However, this is a commonly used method of traveling only after you are in a hurry and have the strength to break through to the Guiyi Realm.
If they are in a hurry, they would rather use the artifact spaceship, even if it is slower.
Because using the artifact spaceship to rush on the road will not only make them appear powerful, but also allow them to get enough rest time.
Jiang Liu wanted to spread the news about this expedition to Jiang's realm throughout the void realm as soon as they set off.
Only in this way can the news reach Jiang Wang's ears quickly.
